(2) The athlete returns to a front-facing relaxed pose, smiling broadly towards the judges and the camera lens. The background is dominated by large 'RIVAL NUTRITION' and 'BEN WEIDER NATURALS' competition banners. His physical movements are controlled and deliberate to maintain muscle tension.

(4) Turning back to face forward, he briefly bows with his palms together in a respectful gesture. He then performs a final front muscular flex before raising his arms in triumph as he concludes the routine. The stage lighting remains constant, emphasizing the depth and texture of his physique.
